EV-000014

Heilbronn problem, 14 points in a convex region of unit area · Heilbronn problems · status unclear

Definition

Maximum over 14 points of min triangle area / area of their convex hull.

\max_P\frac{\min_{a,b,c}\operatorname{area}(abc)}{\operatorname{area}(\operatorname{conv}P)}

Domain: 14 points in the plane. Normalisation: area ratio. Direction: max.

Current value

0.0278 (bound)

Source: https://math.tejstead.com/heilbronn/convex/ https://math.tejstead.com/heilbronn/convex/ 2026-10-12
